item.title: SERB Pharmaceuticals and Hansa Biopharma announce submission to EMA for conversion to standard marketing authorization of Idefirix in the EU
item.description: · SERB has submitted a request to the European Medicines Agency (EMA) to convert the conditional marketing authorization for Idefirix (imlifidase) to standard marketing authorization. · The submission for conversion is based on data from the European Post-Authorization Efficacy and Safety (PAES) study. · Idefirix is the only treatment approved in Europe to enable kidney transplantation in highly sensitized patients with an incompatible organ from a deceased donor. item.title: Advenica's CEO Marie Bengtsson nominated for Årets Kvinnliga Gasell 2026
item.description: Advenica is proud to announce that CEO Marie Bengtsson has been nominated for Årets Kvinnliga Gasell 2026 (Female Gazelle of the Year), an honorary award presented by Dagens Industri, Sweden's leading business newspaper. The award is part of DI Gasell, which recognises the country's fastest-growing companies, and honours a female leader who has driven strong, sustained and profitable growth.
